conclusion.justification: The report explicitly confirms that the claim is true, citing FDA approval and official prescribing information that Kyleena is approved for pregnancy prevention for up to five years.
conclusion.label: endorses

report:
The claim is **true**. Multiple sources confirm that the Kyleena levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system is FDA-approved for pregnancy prevention for up to five years.

**Evidence:**

- A Bayer press release announced FDA approval of Kyleena specifically for the "Prevention of Pregnancy for Up to Five Years" (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/fda-approves-bayers-kyleena-levonorgestrel-releasing-intrauterine-system-195-mg-for-prevention-of-pregnancy-for-up-to-five-years-300330006.html).

- Healionews reported that "The FDA has approved Kyleena for the prevention of pregnancy for up to 5 years, according to a press release issued by the device's manufacturer" (https://www.healio.com/news/primary-care/20160920/fda-approves-bayer-iud-kyleena).

- The official Kyleena patient website states under prescribing information: "Kyleena® (levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system) is a hormone-releasing IUD that prevents pregnancy for up to 5 years" (https://www.kyleena-us.com/prescribing-information).

- Drugs.com similarly notes that "The Kyleena IUD is placed in your uterus by your healthcare provider to prevent pregnancy for up to 5 years" (https://www.drugs.com/kyleena.html).

**Conclusion:** Kyleena is FDA-approved for pregnancy prevention for up to five years.
